messages.content: Who won the last world cup in football?

function.name: get_match_stats
function.description: Retrieve the match statistics of a particular team in a specified sports tournament. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

tournament.description: The name of the sports tournament.

year.description: The year in which the tournament took place. (Optional)

message.content: Argentina won the most recent FIFA World Cup (held in 2022).
message.reasoning:
We need to answer "Who won the last world cup in football?" The user asks about the most recent FIFA World Cup winner. As of current date 2026-10-19, the last completed World Cup was 2022 in Qatar, won by Argentina. But we might consider that the next one will be 2026 in USA/Canada/Mexico but hasn't happened yet. So answer: Argentina.

But we have a tool get_match_stats that can retrieve match stats for a particular team in a specified sports tournament. We could use it to confirm. But it's optional. The question is simple; no need to call the function. But maybe we should call get_match_stats with team_name "Argentina" and tournament "FIFA World Cup" year 2022 to confirm they won. But the function returns match stats, not necessarily winner. But we can still call it. However, the function signature expects team_name, tournament, year optional default 1994. If we want to get stats for Argentina in 2022, we can call get_match_stats({"team_name":"Argentina","tournament":"FIFA World Cup","year":2022}). That would return some data. But the question is just who won. So we can answer directly.

Thus answer: Argentina.
